en.headline: Persistent child sexual abuse offence and cyberflashing to be criminalised
en.dek: The Security Bureau said it would include a new continuous child sexual abuse offence in the sex offences amendment bill after public consultation, and would criminalise sending genital images without consent.
body: The Security Bureau said on Thursday that it would incorporate a new offence of continuous sexual abuse of a child into the forthcoming sex offences amendment bill, and would criminalise the act commonly known as cyberflashing.

Following a one-month public consultation that received more than 6,200 submissions, of which over 99 per cent expressed support, the bureau said it had adopted recommendations to add the continuous child sexual abuse offence. The measure is intended to address cases in which an offender repeatedly abuses a child over a period of time but the victim cannot recall precise dates and details of each incident.

The bureau also confirmed it would criminalise the digital transmission of genital images to a person without their consent. It is working to finalise the bill as soon as possible, with the aim of introducing it to the Legislative Council within this year and completing the legislative process during the current term of government.

The Hong Kong Bar Association welcomed the decision to include the continuous child sexual abuse offence, saying it supported the principle while stressing the need for adequate safeguards to ensure a fair trial. The bureau said it would draw on experience from other common-law jurisdictions when drafting the provisions.

zh.headline: 性罪行修例擬納入持續性侵犯兒童罪 網絡露體刑事化
zh.dek: 保安局表示經公眾諮詢後採納建議，將「持續性侵犯兒童」罪行納入修訂草案，並將未經同意以數碼方式發送生殖器官影像的行為刑事化。
body: 保安局周四表示，經公眾諮詢後，決定將「持續性侵犯兒童」罪行納入性罪行修訂條例草案，並將俗稱「網絡露體」、即在未經受害人同意下以數碼方式發送生殖器官影像的行為刑事化。
當局早前就完善性罪行法例進行為期一個月的公眾諮詢，共收到超過6200份意見，當中超過九成九表示支持。保安局指已採納建議，將「持續性侵犯兒童」罪行納入草案，以處理施害者在一段時間內反覆侵犯兒童、但受害人未必能準確交代每次犯案日期及細節的情況。
保安局提交立法會的文件顯示，正爭取盡快將修訂條例草案定稿，期望今年內提交立法會審議，目標在現屆政府任期內完成立法。
香港大律師公會歡迎政府決定，原則上支持增設有關罪行，同時強調法例須設有充分保障，確保被告獲得公平審訊。當局表示會參考其他普通法司法管轄區的經驗，在處理持續性侵犯兒童案件的同時，恪守無罪推定及公平審訊原則。
